findings.summary: ENG-PLAN-3: the implementation diverged from the plan's Task 4c.4 Files list, and the commit did not edit the plan. (a) The list does not name src/e_agent/contracts/data_classes.py (new public schema_nodes, shared _frontier; amend-scope ruling R1). (b) Line 437 still gives check_format_declarations(document, formats, classes), while lines 85 and 439 of the same plan ask for (document, cap) (PL4-1). The code follows the plan's own stated preference, so the signature is acceptable; the plan is what disagrees with itself. Fix with a docs-only plan edit: name data_classes.py and schema_nodes in the 4c.4 Files list, change line 437 to (document, cap), and record R1 and R2 in the handoff. The report flags this as an open item.

findings.summary: The plan's Live check section and Task 4f.2 do not say that the domain-erp artifact pin must be refreshed before the live check. The digest changed: cb7c29b1... to 9f4fd8c7... The plan's chosen route is 'name it in the handoff' (line 461), and the live-sandbox skill holds the re-pin step. A stale pin fails closed at activation, since check_wheels checks that installed plugin bytes match the trusted wheel inventories. So this is an omission, not drift. Since the plan is being edited for B1-1 anyway, add one line to the Live check preamble, and name the new digest in the 4c.4 handoff.

Idiom nits. The admission loop calls self.schema_document(cap.contract_id) twice per capability. The one-line _types nests a conditional and is dense. value_formats imports CapabilityDescriptor under TYPE_CHECKING to break the capability -> value_formats runtime cycle. That is acceptable inside contracts and lint-imports keeps 12 contracts, but a one-line comment would help.

test_value_formats_never_reach_the_model compares the tool parameters with the plugin's own INPUT_SCHEMAS, so on its own it does not prove the schemas are unchanged from before. That proof comes from the two off goldens, which are byte-identical, and from the full gate. A ref value with a zero-width (Cf) character passes, because only isspace and Cc are refused. ADR 0023 §7 says 'whitespace or control character', so this is within the letter of the ADR. Carry may want to tighten it in 4d.2.
